Giannis Antetokounmpo PUT ON A SHOW as the Miami Heat picked up their second straight win, defeating the Jazz to improve to 5-6! Giannis led the way with 30 points on 12-21 shooting, 11 rebounds and 4 assists, recording his fourth 30-point, 10-rebound game of the season. That ties him for the league lead in that category!
